title: Building query strings
hints: Gluing strings together doesn't escape anything: "go & rust" puts a literal & into the query, which starts a new parameter.
Parse base with url.Parse, take its existing parameters with u.Query(), Set the new ones, and write them back with u.RawQuery = values.Encode().
Encode escapes each value, so "a+b" becomes "a%2Bb" and the + survives. Return u.String().
